title: Technical SEO Audit & Site Crawler input
description: Give the site to audit, usually its homepage. The crawler follows internal links and sitemaps, and you get one row per audited URL with its issues and score.

startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description: Where the audit starts. Use the homepage to audit a whole site, or switch Crawl scope to "Only the URLs I list" to check specific pages.

maxPages.title: Maximum URLs to audit
maxPages.description: The audit stops after this many URLs. Every fetched URL counts as one result, including redirects and error pages.

crawlScope.title: Crawl scope
crawlScope.description: Which links the crawler follows from the start URLs.
enumTitles: Same hostname (www and non-www count as one)
Only URLs under the start URL's folder
Only the URLs I list (do not follow links)

useSitemap.title: Read XML sitemaps
useSitemap.description: Finds sitemaps through robots.txt and /sitemap.xml, audits the URLs they list, and reports orphan pages and sitemap errors.

respectRobotsTxt.title: Respect robots.txt
respectRobotsTxt.description: Skips URLs that robots.txt disallows for this crawler and honours Crawl-delay (up to 3 seconds). Turn off only for sites you own or are authorised to audit.

maxDepth.title: Maximum click depth
maxDepth.description: How many clicks from a start URL the crawler will go.
maxDepth.sectionDescription: Fine-tune what is crawled and how fast.

maxConcurrency.title: Parallel requests
maxConcurrency.description: Number of pages fetched at once. Requests to one host are also capped at about 10 per second.

includeUrlPatterns.title: Only audit URLs matching
includeUrlPatterns.description: Optional. Text or wildcard patterns, for example */blog/*. A URL must match at least one pattern to be audited.

excludeUrlPatterns.title: Skip URLs matching
excludeUrlPatterns.description: Optional. Text or wildcard patterns, for example */tag/* or ?replytocom=.

userAgent.title: Custom User-Agent
userAgent.description: Optional. By default the crawler identifies itself as SiteAuditBot. Set a custom value if your firewall only allows a specific token.
